trace_file.description: The path to the nam trace file to be animated.

geometry.description: Window geometry specification for the nam GUI. Format: WxH+X+Y.

update_interval.description: Screen update rate in milliseconds. Default is 50ms.

app_name.description: Application name for peer synchronization (peer sync).

peer_name.description: Application name of the peer nam instance to synchronize with. Empty if standalone.

cache_size.description: Maximum size of the cache used for backward animation.

init_file.description: Name of an initialization file to load during startup.

sync_x.description: Enable synchronous X behavior for graphics debugging.

layout_attractive.description: Attractive force constant for automatic layout algorithm.

layout_repulsive.description: Repulsive force constant for automatic layout algorithm.

layout_iterations.description: Number of iterations for automatic layout algorithm.
